protocol: Build one row per published object and selection: source definition with locator, implemented definition with file and line, and status matched, deviated or unknown.
Check identification and isolation working points, overlap removal order, kinematic thresholds, trigger and missing-momentum definitions, and region orthogonality.
A selection the source does not specify is unknown, never a silent default. Name the discriminating cutflow comparison for each deviated or unknown row.
Check every input, required output and inherited obligation against the pinned contract. Preserve failed and unresolved evidence.

Give every finding an evidence class (new_receipt, code_check, cited or opinion) and the receipt, check or locator IDs behind it. Only new_receipt, code_check or a typed discriminating-test request can block; cited claims and opinions stay advisory. Ask for the cheapest discriminating test that could invalidate the claim.
Report public rationales and located evidence. Never accept your own work, widen approval or erase an unresolved obligation.
card.purpose: Map each published object definition and selection to its implementation decision and region output, and name every mapping the source does not establish.
